task.title: Phase N N6.3: VisualBaselineStore with private keys, signed indexes and records, keyless invalidate-first lifecycle hooks and a corrected cross-process flows-folder lock
task.objective: Implement awkit-vra.15.3 per the ratified N6 plan: a corrected cross-process exclusive lock (src/storage/crossProcessLock.ts: hard-link publish, no TTL, per-dead-owner claims, owner-verified release and fencing, event-driven bounded waits, typed errors, no re-entrancy) because DurableLockStore is unsafe for shared flow storage; optional flow-only JsonProfileStore hooks; the keyless lifecycle (tokens and lock in the flows folder's private subfolder keyed by its native real path, invalidate-first on every writer, purge of changed or removed steps, quarantine coordination, fail-safe fallback without hard links); VisualBaselineStore with a private safeStorage-protected master key per app mode, HKDF keys, key-state marker, signed indexes and records holding only length-prefixed HMAC commitments, coordinated approval with staleness re-checks, bounded sweep and unchecked reset; the production safeStorage protector (not wired to IPC); and the four verifiers store, integrity, lifecycle and the two-process cross-process gate X1-X8 with mutation controls. No runner execution, IPC, UI, grants, report or import authorization (N6.4-N6.9).

acceptance.description: The store implements VA-5, VA-6 and VA-14: signed indexes and records with only length-prefixed HMAC commitments, private per-mode keys never in the general secret store, defined key and integrity failure modes, verified by verify:visual-baseline-store and verify:visual-baseline-integrity with every mutant red.

Every flow writer invalidates or purges before its write without the key, approvals cannot race stale, crashes never revive approvals, other stores and non-visual flows are unaffected, verified by verify:visual-baseline-lifecycle with every mutant red and by the existing profile-store, write-queue, legacy-compat, storage-assertions and runner verifiers.
Two real processes on one flows folder pass X1-X8 and each cross-process mutant fails its scenario.
Build and typecheck pass, visual isolation unchanged at three edges, verifiers classified, awkit-vra.15.3 closed, dashboard pins updated and Sources agree, work pushed to main.
